newsitem.title: USA: Agouron to enlarge VIRACEPT(R) program.
newsitem.headline: Agouron to enlarge VIRACEPT(R) program.

text.p: Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Wednesday it will enlarge the expanded access program which supplies the company's HIV protease inhibitor, VIRACEPT(R), (nelfinavir mesylate), without charge to qualified adults with advanced HIV disease.
People will now qualify for the VIRACEPT Expanded Access Program if they are unable to take other drugs due to intolerance or prior failure and other conditions.

Previously the eligibility criteria was more restrictive. Expanded access programs represent an effort by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to make investigational drugs available at the earliest opportunity to people in need.
